hypotheses.justification: This instance can be deleted. From `[CharP k p]`, `CharP.char_is_prime_or_zero k p` splits into `p.Prime` or `p = 0`. In the prime case, locally install `Fact p.Prime` and use the existing proof. In the zero case, take `D = C`: since `G` is finite, `Nat.card C` is positive, so `¬ 0 ∣ Nat.card C`; also `D.relIndex C = 1` and `0 ^ (Nat.card C).factorization 0 = 1`, making the class equality reflexive. Thus the conclusion holds in both cases without the argument.
